### Giving with Discretion
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/giving-discretion
Passage: Matthew 6:1-4
Points:
- Worldly philanthropy frequently seeks public accolades and social praise for generosity.
- Jesus warns believers against practicing charitable giving for the applause of other people.
- Christ cautions against ostentatious displays that call attention to one's own benevolence.
- God evaluates the inner intent of the heart rather than merely outward compliance.
- Disciples should give quietly, valuing God's approval far above human commendation.
